slides.h:
📈 Quadratic Functions二次函数

Vertex form & transformations顶点式与图象变换

Why memorize dozens of parabolas? Every one of them is just y=x2 stretched, flipped and slid — and vertex form tells you exactly how.何必死记各种抛物线？每一条都只是 y=x2 经过拉伸、翻折、平移得到的——顶点式把怎么变的全写在脸上。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 30 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Vertex form & transformations顶点式与图象变换
  1. y=a(x−p)2+q: vertex (p,q), axis x=p. (x+3)2 means p=−3.y=a(x−p)2+q：顶点 (p,q)，对称轴 x=p。(x+3)2 表示 p=−3。
  2. ∣a∣>1 narrower, ∣a∣<1 wider, a<0 flips. From the vertex: over 1, 2, 3 → up a, 4a, 9a.∣a∣>1 变窄，∣a∣<1 变宽，a<0 翻转。从顶点出发：右移 1、2、3 → 上升 a、4a、9a。
  3. x-intercepts: a,q opposite signs → 2; q=0 → 1; same signs → 0.x 截距个数：a,q 异号 → 2 个；q=0 → 1 个；同号 → 0 个。
y=a(x−p)2+q
(x,y) → (x+p, ay+q)

🧗 The hard part难点 · Vertex form & transformations顶点式与图象变换

Equation from the vertex and one point由顶点和一个点写方程

People put the vertex in with the wrong signs or substitute the vertex itself to find a.常见错误是顶点代入时符号写反，或拿顶点本身去求 a。

  1. Vertex (−2,5): y=a(x+2)2+5顶点 (−2,5)：y=a(x+2)2+5
  2. Other point (1,−13): −13=a(3)2+5另一点 (1,−13)：−13=a(3)2+5
  3. 9a=−18⇒a=−2
  4. Sense check: point below the vertex ⇒ a<0检验：点在顶点下方 ⇒ a<0
Try试一试
Write the equation of the parabola with vertex (−2,5) through (1,−13).写出顶点为 (−2,5) 且过 (1,−13) 的抛物线方程。
Answer答案
y=−2(x+2)2+5

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Vertex form & transformations顶点式与图象变换
  • Vertex of y=2(x+5)2−1 as (5,−1) → (−5,−1).y=2(x+5)2−1 的顶点写成 (5,−1) → 应为 (−5,−1)。
  • a=31​ called narrower → vertical stretch by 31​ makes it wider.a=31​ 说成变窄 → 竖直伸缩因子 31​，图象变宽。
🎯
To find a, substitute the OTHER point, not the vertex: one line gives a=(x1​−p)2y1​−q​.求 a 时代入另一个点，别代顶点：一行得 a=(x1​−p)2y1​−q​。

cards.f: Vertex of y=a(x−p)2+q?y=a(x−p)2+q 的顶点？
cards.b: (p,q); axis x=p.(p,q)；对称轴 x=p。

cards.f: y=(x+5)2 moves which way?y=(x+5)2 往哪边移？
cards.b: 5 units LEFT (opposite of the sign).向左 5 个单位（与符号相反）。

cards.f: Step pattern for y=x2 from the vertex?y=x2 从顶点出发的步长规律？
cards.b: Over 1 up 1, over 2 up 4, over 3 up 9 (multiply by a for other parabolas).横 1 竖 1，横 2 竖 4，横 3 竖 9（其他抛物线都乘以 a）。

cards.f: How many x-intercepts does y=3(x−1)2+2 have?y=3(x−1)2+2 有几个 x 截距？
cards.b: None: a>0 and q>0 (opens up, vertex above the axis).0 个：a>0 且 q>0（开口向上，顶点在 x 轴上方）。

cards.f: First move to write an equation from a vertex and a point?已知顶点和一点，求解析式的第一步？
cards.b: Write y=a(x−p)2+q with the vertex filled in, then substitute the point to get a.把顶点填进 y=a(x−p)2+q，再代入那个点求 a。

quiz.q: State the vertex, axis of symmetry and range of y=3(x−4)2+1.写出 y=3(x−4)2+1 的顶点、对称轴和值域。
quiz.hint: a=3>0 opens up.a=3>0，开口向上。
quiz.ans: vertex (4,1), axis x=4, range y≥1顶点 (4,1)，对称轴 x=4，值域 y≥1
quiz.why: p=4, q=1; opens up so the range is y≥1.p=4，q=1；开口向上，值域 y≥1。

quiz.q: Which transformations take y=x2 to y=−21​(x+2)2−3?y=x2 经过哪些变换得到 y=−21​(x+2)2−3？
opts: stretch by 21​, reflect in x-axis, left 2, down 3纵向压缩为 21​，关于 x 轴对称，向左平移 2，向下平移 3
stretch by 2, reflect in x-axis, right 2, down 3纵向拉伸为 2 倍，关于 x 轴对称，向右平移 2，向下平移 3
stretch by 21​, right 2, down 3纵向压缩为 21​，向右平移 2，向下平移 3
stretch by 21​, reflect in y-axis, left 2, up 3纵向压缩为 21​，关于 y 轴对称，向左平移 2，向上平移 3
quiz.hint: a=−21​, p=−2, q=−3.a=−21​，p=−2，q=−3。
quiz.ans: vertical stretch by a factor of 21​, reflection in the x-axis, 2 left, 3 down竖直伸缩为原来的 21​，关于 x 轴翻折，向左 2，向下 3
quiz.why: Negative a reflects in the x-axis; (x+2) is 2 left; −3 is 3 down.a 为负 → 关于 x 轴翻折；(x+2) → 向左 2；−3 → 向下 3。

quiz.q: How many x-intercepts does y=−2(x−1)2+8 have? Find them.y=−2(x−1)2+8 有几个 x 截距？求出它们。
quiz.hint: a<0, q>0. Then set y=0 and isolate the square.a<0，q>0。再令 y=0，把平方项单独留在一边。
quiz.ans: Two: x=−1 and x=3两个：x=−1 和 x=3
quiz.why: 2(x−1)2=8⇒(x−1)2=4⇒x−1=±2.2(x−1)2=8⇒(x−1)2=4⇒x−1=±2。

quiz.q: Write the equation of the parabola with vertex (−1,4) passing through (1,−4).求顶点为 (−1,4)、经过 (1,−4) 的抛物线方程。
quiz.hint: −4=a(1+1)2+4
quiz.ans: y=−2(x+1)2+4
quiz.why: −4=4a+4⇒a=−2.−4=4a+4⇒a=−2。

quiz.q: The graph of y=x2 is stretched vertically by a factor of 3, reflected in the x-axis, then moved 5 left and 2 down. Its equation is:y=x2 的图象竖直拉伸为原来的 3 倍，关于 x 轴翻折，再向左平移 5、向下平移 2。所得方程是：
opts: y=−3(x−5)2−2
y=−3(x+5)2−2
y=3(x+5)2−2
y=−31​(x+5)2−2
quiz.hint: Left 5 means p=−5, so the bracket is (x+5).向左 5 即 p=−5，括号是 (x+5)。
quiz.ans: y=−3(x+5)2−2
quiz.why: a=−3, p=−5, q=−2.a=−3，p=−5，q=−2。

quiz.q: A parabola has axis of symmetry x=−1 and passes through (1,2) and (2,−3). Find its equation.一条抛物线的对称轴是 x=−1，经过 (1,2) 和 (2,−3)。求它的方程。
quiz.hint: y=a(x+1)2+q; substitute both points and subtract.设 y=a(x+1)2+q，代入两点后相减。
quiz.ans: y=−(x+1)2+6
quiz.why: 2=4a+q and −3=9a+q. Subtract: −5=5a, so a=−1, q=6.2=4a+q，−3=9a+q。相减：−5=5a，a=−1，q=6。

quiz.q: A skateboard ramp profile is y=0.5(x−4)2 (metres), for 0≤x≤4. How high is the ramp where it starts (x=0), and how far from the start is it 2 m high?滑板坡道的剖面是 y=0.5(x−4)2（米），0≤x≤4。起点（x=0）有多高？离起点多远处高 2 m？
quiz.hint: Solve 0.5(x−4)2=2 and keep the root in 0≤x≤4.解 0.5(x−4)2=2，保留 0≤x≤4 内的根。
quiz.ans: 8 m high at the start; 2 m high at x=2起点高 8 m；在 x=2 处高 2 m
quiz.why: y(0)=0.5(16)=8.y(0)=0.5(16)=8。

quiz.q: A gondola cable hangs between two towers 80 m apart. Each tower top is 36 m above the valley floor, and the lowest point of the cable, midway between the towers, is 4 m above the floor. Put the origin on the floor under the left tower and model the cable as a parabola. (a) Write its equation in vertex form. (b) At what horizontal distances from the left tower is the cable 12 m above the floor? (c) Explain why those two distances must add to 80.一条缆车钢缆挂在相距 80 m 的两座塔之间。每座塔顶离谷底 36 m，钢缆最低点在两塔正中间，离谷底 4 m。以左塔正下方的谷底为原点，把钢缆看成抛物线。(a) 写出顶点式方程。(b) 离左塔多远的地方，钢缆离谷底 12 m？(c) 解释为什么这两个距离的和必为 80。
quiz.hint: The lowest point is the vertex (40,4); a tower top such as (0,36) gives a.最低点是顶点 (40,4)；塔顶 (0,36) 可求出 a。
quiz.ans: y=0.02(x−40)2+4; x=20 and x=60; they are mirror images about x=40y=0.02(x−40)2+4；x=20 和 x=60；两者关于 x=40 对称
quiz.why: The vertex is midway at x=40, height 4: y=a(x−40)2+4.顶点在正中间 x=40、高度 4：y=a(x−40)2+4。
